title: Deferral and maintenance release authority chain
description: Prepare the deferral evidence in order, check for conflicting work on the aircraft, and route it through an authority chain that cannot be reordered or skipped.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-flt-04
  title: Deferral and maintenance release authority chain
  description: Prepare the deferral evidence in order, check for conflicting work on the aircraft, and
    route it through an authority chain that cannot be reordered or skipped.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Defer a defect only after the MEL category, required procedures, and operational penalty
    are established, with each authority signing in the order the procedure requires.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-authority-1
      - n-authority-2
      - n-authority-3
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Defect report and aircraft state
      summary: Defect report and aircraft state
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - defect_report
              - aircraft_configuration
              - planned_sectors
              - open_deferrals
            properties:
              defect_report: {}
              aircraft_configuration: {}
              planned_sectors: {}
              open_deferrals: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-scope
      kind: transform
      name: Select the defect and affected systems
      summary: select the defect, the affected systems, and the sectors the deferral would apply to
      config:
        operation: select
        expression: select the defect, the affected systems, and the sectors the deferral would apply
          to
    - id: n-prep1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: flt-07
      name: MEL category and repair interval determination
      summary: 'Preparation step 1: mel category and repair interval determination.'
      role: Controller determining dispatch legality with inoperative items and open maintenance.
      prompt: You are a MEL & Airworthiness Controller. You determine whether the aircraft is airworthy
        for the intended operation with its open items, applying the minimum equipment list category,
        repair interval, and every operational and maintenance procedure the deferral requires. You state
        the operational penalty each deferral carries and refuse a deferral whose required procedure has
        not actually been performed, because an MEL item without its (M) procedure is an unairworthy aircraft
        with paperwork.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:maintenance-system
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-prep2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: flt-04
      name: Operational penalty and performance effect
      summary: 'Preparation step 2: operational penalty and performance effect.'
      role: Performance specialist computing takeoff, landing, and weight-and-balance limits for the actual
        conditions.
      prompt: You are an Aircraft Performance Engineer. You compute takeoff and landing performance and
        the weight and balance envelope for the actual runway, contamination state, temperature, pressure,
        obstacle environment, and aircraft configuration, and you name the limiting factor for each figure.
        You never apply a performance credit the configuration does not support — an inoperative system,
        a contaminated surface, or an unverified braking action changes the number, and reporting the
        clean-runway figure is how an overrun is planned.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - quantitative-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - teaching
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:performance-tool
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-prep3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: flt-01
      name: Dispatch effect on the planned sectors
      summary: 'Preparation step 3: dispatch effect on the planned sectors.'
      role: Licensed dispatcher holding joint responsibility with the captain for the safe conduct of
        a flight.
      prompt: You are a Flight Dispatcher. You assemble the operational flight plan, fuel figure, alternates,
        and dispatch release, and you hold joint responsibility with the captain — a release you would
        not defend is a release you do not issue. You state the specific regulation, operations specification,
        or company minimum behind every dispatch condition, and you never release a flight on an assumption
        about weather, airworthiness, or crew legality that has not been verified by the person accountable
        for it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - release-engineering
          - evidence-verification
          - compliance-review
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:flight-planning
          - mcp:ops-control
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-preparation
      kind: group
      name: Deferral evidence sequence
      summary: Each preparation step consumes the previous one; the group exits only after the whole sequence
        has been serialized in the order the permit requires.
      config:
        members:
          - n-prep1
          - n-prep2
          - n-prep3
        execution: sequential
        exit: serialize
    - id: n-conflict
      kind: condition
      name: Simultaneous operations conflict?
      summary: Route on the deferral interacts with another open deferral or with maintenance in progress.
      config:
        expression: the deferral interacts with another open deferral or with maintenance in progress
        branches:
          - label: Clear
            when: clear
          - label: Conflict
            when: conflict
    - id: n-deconflict
      kind: agent
      templateRef: flt-07
      name: Resolve the interacting work before any signature
      summary: Resolve the conflicting activity before any authority signs.
      role: Controller determining dispatch legality with inoperative items and open maintenance.
      prompt: You are a MEL & Airworthiness Controller. You determine whether the aircraft is airworthy
        for the intended operation with its open items, applying the minimum equipment list category,
        repair interval, and every operational and maintenance procedure the deferral requires. You state
        the operational penalty each deferral carries and refuse a deferral whose required procedure has
        not actually been performed, because an MEL item without its (M) procedure is an unairworthy aircraft
        with paperwork.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:maintenance-system
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-authority-1
      kind: approval
      name: Certifying engineer signs the deferral
      summary: Pause for the certifying engineer; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: n-authority-2
      kind: approval
      name: Maintenance control accepts the deferral
      summary: Pause for maintenance control; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: n-authority-3
      kind: approval
      name: Dispatcher accepts the aircraft for the planned sectors
      summary: Pause for the licensed flight dispatcher; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Deferral and maintenance release authority chain deliverable, the
        evidence behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-flt-04-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-scope
      kind: data
    - id: wf-flt-04-edge-2
      from: n-scope
      to: n-preparation
      kind: data
    - id: wf-flt-04-edge-3
      from: n-preparation
      to: n-conflict
      kind: data
    - id: wf-flt-04-edge-4
      from: n-conflict
      to: n-authority-1
      kind: control
      condition: clear
    - id: wf-flt-04-edge-5
      from: n-conflict
      to: n-deconflict
      kind: control
      condition: conflict
    - id: wf-flt-04-edge-6
      from: n-deconflict
      to: n-authority-1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-flt-04-edge-7
      from: n-authority-1
      to: n-authority-2
      kind: control
      condition: approved
    - id: wf-flt-04-edge-8
      from: n-authority-2
      to: n-authority-3
      kind: control
      condition: approved
    - id: wf-flt-04-edge-9
      from: n-authority-3
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
